verdict.rationale: Claude Design's built-in AI generates visuals and designs from descriptions inside the editor. Hands-on reports confirm this: a prompted illustration ('Bear on a bicycle') came out underwhelming, and another user generated animated SVGs. The evidence only implies copy generation, through prompt-driven content such as turning a proposal into a one-pager, and never mentions dedicated asset-chore tools. Missing for 10: background removal, content-aware fill, explicit copy-suggestion features, true raster image generation, and strong documentation or corroboration of asset-editing workflows.
